title: Spectral Boundary Observer for Counter-Flow Heat Exchangers
summary: We consider a system of two coupled first-order linear hyperbolic partial differential equations modeling heat transport in a counter-flow heat exchanger: one equation describes the transport of a hot fluid, and the other the transport of a cold fluid in the opposite direction. For this system, we design a boundary observer that uses only the temperature of the cold fluid measured at one boundary.
